findings.title: SUTRADHAR_ALLOWED_DOWNLOAD_ROOTS (advertised as the override) does not beat a discovered out-of-tree downloadDir; CLI exits 1 / MCP dies
findings.repro: r/.git; r/.sutradhar.json={"downloadDir":"../out"}; cd r/sub; SUTRADHAR_ALLOWED_DOWNLOAD_ROOTS=<abs> sutradhar nav about:blank -> exit 1 "...To allow it anyway, set SUTRADHAR_ALLOWED_DOWNLOAD_ROOTS..."
findings.required_fix: Apply the containment refusal only when the file supplies the effective download layer (no env/option roots); keep D7 for malformed values; or drop the env advice from message/README/SECURITY/spec 7.1. Add a live CLI+MCP test.

findings.title: firstDefined treats null as a value: createSutradharServer({allowedDomains:null}) ignores env + config and runs unrestricted (regression vs master, which applied the env var); same for SDK option null and dialogPolicy null
findings.required_fix: Treat null as absent (value == null) in firstDefined; add null rows to the precedence tests.

findings.title: Home boundary bypass: cwd that is a junction/symlink inside HOME pointing outside makes the walk read .sutradhar.json ABOVE home
findings.required_fix: inHome = literal OR canonical containment; stop at home on literal or canonical equality; unit test.

findings.title: Docs claim error messages never repeat file values; allowedDomains/idleTimeoutMs values (<=64 chars), download entries (unbounded) and unknown key names (unbounded, 20k-char key -> 20,220-char warning every command) are echoed
findings.required_fix: Redact/cap echoes (incl. key names) or correct docs/project-config.md and the changelog fragment.

findings.title: SECURITY.md / GAP-341 cite "the runtime re-checks every download itself" as TOCTOU mitigation; findContainingRoot canonicalises the root too, so a root swapped for a junction passes
findings.repro: findContainingRoot(root/f,[root]) after replacing root with a junction to outside -> contained (true)
findings.required_fix: Correct SECURITY.md/GAP-341, or re-check root-vs-config-dir containment at download time.

findings.title: Empty --allowlist-domains is now an error (behaviour change) but --help and CLI README are silent and docs/project-config.md says empty counts as not set at the flag layer
findings.repro: sutradhar nav x --allowlist-domains "" -> Error: --allowlist-domains needs at least one domain

findings.title: Test gap: home-boundary equality mutants (A8, A8b) survive all unit suites; only the auditor probe catches them
findings.repro: node audit-1/probes/mutants.mjs <scr> A8b -> unit all pass; loader diff SRCH.home.caseVariantHome
findings.required_fix: Add discovery unit tests with a case-variant/trailing-separator homedir and a junction cwd.

findings.title: Config viewport has no upper bound: {"viewport":{"width":1e9,...}} validates, then every CLI command spawns a Chrome, fails setDeviceMetricsOverride (>10,000,000) and LEAKS that Chrome (not in state, close cannot reach it). Same leak exists for the flag on master; the file makes it persistent and repo-controlled
findings.repro: {"viewport":{"width":1000000000,"height":1000000000}}; sutradhar nav about:blank -> Fatal: Protocol error ... not greater than 10000000; chrome.exe left running
findings.required_fix: Validate viewport width/height <= 10,000,000 (schema maximum + hand validator); ideally kill the spawned Chrome when post-spawn setup fails.

findings.title: allowedDomains accepts single numeric/TLD labels ("1","com"); with suffix matching "1" allows any host ending ".1" (narrowing only, pre-existing matcher). SDK does not announce a discovered dialog accept (opt-in surface).
